content:
leah_sales: FYI — FinCorp POC ask landed. They want BYO-KMS + HSM (CloudHSM) with per-tenant key separation, <10ms tail latency for real-time scoring, and a 7-day rotation window. Need ops & security signoff.

mike_se: can you paste the exact acceptance criteria? latency at inference path or total end-to-end? :thinking_face:

leah_sales: good call — they said <10ms added for key unwrap during inference (per-token budgets are tight). End-to-end ~50ms is fine. Also asking about key escrow & split custody for compliance.

olivia_sec: couple quick things: 1) BYO-KMS + HSM is fine but CloudHSM adds network hop — need colocated subnet or private link to hit <10ms. 2) rotation semantics: if they require 7-day automatic rotation, we need to confirm whether they want overlapping key TTLs (pre- and post-rotation) and how we handle cached KV maps in the runtime.

mike_se: runtime currently caches unwrap results and a short-lived DEK (data-encryption key) in-memory for scoring. Typical cache TTL is 300s. If they rotate every 7 days we should support multi-key cache and a grace period, e.g.:

```
# example: handling rotation
- keep active_key, previous_key
- accept tokens signed by either for 72h after rotation
- proactively fetch new KEK from KMS on rollout
```

leah_sales: FinCorp also wants a model for pricing impact if we use dedicated HSM paths vs our proxy key manager. They asked for a predicted delta in per-1M-requests cost.

mike_se: roughs: HSM egress and HSM-per-request unwrap adds CPU + network; with batching we can amortize. I'll run a microbenchmark with seq len 64 and batch 8 to estimate per-unwrap cost. Expect +0.5–1.5 ms per request if we call HSM per inference, less if we keep DEK cached.

olivia_sec: required Qs for their security questionnaire: key lifecycle, rotation policy, audit trail retention (they want 7 years), attestation reports for HSM (FIPS 140-2/3), and whether we persist any plaintext keys. We must confirm we never write DEKs to disk and we only store key metadata and wrapped keys.

customer_cto: @leah_sales quick clarifying Q: We prefer the HSM in our cloud account (BYO-HSM). Does Redwood support VPC-peered HSM endpoints or only public endpoints with VPN?

leah_sales: we support VPC interfaces and private link for some providers. I'll confirm exact providers & network topology.

jane_legal: one contract note: if the customer brings their own KMS/HSM, we need an addendum for key escrow liability and a clause about rotation windows impacting availability. Suggest adding a 4hr maintenance SLA during key rollouts for canary cutovers.

mike_se: operational checklist I'm going to produce for the POC: network path & perf test, rotation test plan, failure injection (HSM outage), test vectors for token unwrap, SLO smoke tests. Will include commands for the customer to run from their VPC.

mike_se: sample perf test snippet we can share with FinCorp:

```
# perf test: unwrap + score
ab -n 1000 -c 8 -p payload.json https://redwood-poc/score
# measure p95 on unwrap RPCs to KMS
```

olivia_sec: also require cryptographic proof vectors: AES-GCM wrap/unwarp examples, KMS ARN usage, and attestation report (cert). I'll draft answers to the questionnaire sections.

leah_sales: blockers we need resolved before we sign SOW: 1) confirm private connectivity option and expected latency (mike), 2) acceptance criteria for rotation fallback (olivia), 3) delta pricing model for HSM vs proxy (finance estimate).

mike_se: I'll run the microbench and post numbers by EOD. If private link yields <2ms median to HSM we're good.

olivia_sec: proposal for rotation fallback: if active key unwrap fails, auto-fallback to previous_key for 72h, emit audit event, and surface to Console as degraded-key-state. Need customer ok.

customer_cto: fallback sounds reasonable. One more ask: can we do split-escrow so two custodians must sign for a restore? Compliance will need it.

leah_sales: noted — include split custody in SOW as optional add-on.

deploy_bot: Deployment plan created: poc/fin_fcorp/kms-hsm-integration v1 — tests queued.

mike_se: OK posted initial numbers in thread: median unwrap w/ private link = 1.3ms, p95 = 3.9ms, total inference add = ~2.8ms with caching. Will attach CSV in the repo.

olivia_sec: I'll draft the questionnaire responses (keys & rotation), and add required attestations. I'll ping legal for the addendum language.

leah_sales: thanks team — I'll update FinCorp tonight with our plan, perf numbers, and SOW options (standard BYO-HSM, BYO-HSM + split-escrow add-on). :thumbsup:
